summary: Upgrades old LyShine slice-based UI assets to the Shine prefab-based format: .uicanvas files to v4 (flat ChildEntities) and UI .slice files to .uiprefab. Enable this Gem alongside Shine, run 'convert_slices' then 'upgrade_canvases', verify, then disable.
requirements: Requires both the old LyShine slice system and the new Shine Gem to be available.
